My role

I programmed the game, including attack selection and coroutine-based behaviour. The artwork came from the asset store.

Technical approach

I worked on the attack manager and on handling attempts to activate an attack that was already running. The chosen approach selected a different attack instead of simply cancelling the action.

Result

The project gave me practice managing simultaneous actions and game state in C#.
